g.text: The Modernization Agent Fleet · Bounded Pipeline by Stage
Nine specialized agents across ﬁve sequential stages. Each agent has a named owner. The pipeline terminates at hand-over.
all four must pass to advance
The modernization ﬂeet runs a project-bounded pipeline. Inputs (legacy code, supporting artifacts, target blueprint) enter once at the start. Agents
operate sequentially across the ﬁve stages. The migration and validation agents iterate per scoped module until the gates pass. Once the migration is
complete and the modern system is deployed, the pipeline terminates. The Maintain stage continues until hand-over.
Distinct from the SDLC ﬂeet's continuous loop. Same methodology principles (structured representation, agent constraint, named ownership, validation gates) shaped to the bounded use case.
HUMAN VALIDATION POINT 1 · CUSTODIAN SME ANNOTATION
Before Stage 3 begins. The four custodians annotate every Source-state module with
Retain / Modify / Replace / Retire. The annotation becomes the parity contract.
After every gate-pass iteration, at module completion, and at hand-over. The
Modernization Expert reviews the target code output. Everything between the two points is agentic.
